edit.description: Early same-clock historical forecasts, smoothly approach frozen static teachers
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity: no decoded final affinity or descendant survival evidence was delivered, so the primary objective cannot be confirmed; the edit may leave predicted target affinity unchanged or worse, and this must be assessed first before any coordinate claim.

Strain/validity: the reward acts only on a predicted endpoint world-A coordinate proxy via the FLOWR endpoint VJP; it can be satisfied by distorted geometry, so strain and structural validity must be reported separately and may degrade even if the coordinate contrast appears.

Trace: if the compiled S1 table does not change the landmark_00_local_dx trace, or the late-window rate sign does not remain positive under the registered recipe, H001 is falsified and the edit is inert.

Scope: the contrast is only supported over [0.0,0.49]; any extrapolation beyond the observed score nodes is rejected, and no stage boundary or phase knot is data-supported (stage/temporal profiles unavailable).
Cross-coordinate: only landmark_00_local_dx was inspected; other landmarks and soft_mass were not read, so consistency of the contrast across coordinates is unverified.
rationale: Analyst H001/H002, grounded in the actual landmark_00_local_dx curve (E4bbe368c52deda38) and the clock metadata (E0857891f4effbfe1), support a time-dependent contrast rather than a stationary absolute coordinate target: the curve is non-monotone with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts, endpoint rates are oppositely signed (early negative, late positive), the whole-window mean is near zero, and a degree-2 polynomial is rejected. The reward lane preserves dose_factors=1 and frozen eta, so the registered S1_observed_to_static recipe (blend 1->0.5->0 over knots 0/0.5/1, delta and dose fixed at 1) is the offered choice that makes early same-clock observed forecasts dominant and smoothly hands off to frozen static teachers, matching the observed early-negative to late-positive rate reversal within the observed support [0.0,0.49] without extrapolation. S2 (constant blend) would discard the staged relevance the contrast requires, and S3 is the opposite-relevance control, so neither is selected.
